receipt_dimensions_positive.name: receipt_dimensions_positive
receipt_dimensions_positive.value: ("manual_payment_receipts"."width" is null or "manual_payment_receipts"."width" > 0) and ("manual_payment_receipts"."height" is null or "manual_payment_receipts"."height" > 0)

bale_has_no_card_settings.name: bale_has_no_card_settings
bale_has_no_card_settings.value: "payment_method_configs"."method" = 'card_to_card' or ("payment_method_configs"."bank_name" is null and "payment_method_configs"."cardholder_name" is null and "payment_method_configs"."card_number" is null and "payment_method_configs"."account_iban" is null and "payment_method_configs"."instructions" is null and "payment_method_configs"."manual_review_message" is null and "payment_method_configs"."manual_review_hold_hours" is null)

user_identity.name: user_identity
user_identity.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null
